newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mahathir says needs time to heal Singapore rift.
newsitem.headline: Mahathir says needs time to heal Singapore rift.

text.p: Malaysia will need time to heal the hurt caused by remarks made by Singapore Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew, said Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad, The Star newspaper reported on Monday.
"Although we feel it's all over, like the saying goes, only time can heal a broken heart," Mahathir was quoted as saying on Sunday after returning from an official visit to Saudi Arabia.
The Malaysian Cabinet accepted Lee's apology last Wednesday over disparaging remarks he had made in a court affidavit about the southern Malaysian state of Johor.
Mahathir added that he would not set any conditions on Singapore to mend ties.
"I have no wish to, in any way, put down conditions or anything like that," he was quoted as saying.
